mapper.sql: jobid, sitecode, tcjobid, status, jobname, imagesjson, facecount, enablepbr, folderid, modelid, previewurl, errorcode, errormsg, polls, saveretries, create_by, createtime, updatetime, finishtime
mapper.insert: insert into u_s_model_job(jobid, sitecode, tcjobid, status, jobname, imagesjson, facecount, enablepbr, folderid, polls, saveretries, create_by, createtime, updatetime) values(#{jobId}, #{siteCode}, #{tcJobId}, #{status}, #{jobName}, #{imagesJson}, #{faceCount}, coalesce(#{enablePbr}, 0), #{folderId}, 0, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update u_s_model_job set status = #{status}, tcjobid = #{tcJobId}, modelid = #{modelId}, previewurl = #{previewUrl}, errorcode = #{errorCode}, errormsg = #{errorMsg}, polls = coalesce(#{polls}, polls), saveretries = coalesce(#{saveRetries}, saveretries), finishtime = #{finishtime}, updatetime = sysdate() where jobid = #{jobId}
mapper.select: select from u_s_model_job where status in ('SUBMITTING', 'WAIT', 'RUN', 'SAVING') order by createtime limit #{limit}
select from u_s_model_job order by createtime desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from u_s_model_job where createtime >= #{since}
